mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_user_coupon_settlement_projection_outbox WHERE status='NEW' OR (status='RETRY' AND retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_coupon_settlement_projection_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',worker_id=#{workerId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil},update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('NEW','RETRY')

UPDATE t_user_coupon_settlement_projection_outbox SET status='DONE',worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND worker_id=#{workerId} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE t_user_coupon_settlement_projection_outbox SET status='RETRY',retry_at=#{retryAt},attempts=#{attempts},last_error=#{lastError},worker_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND worker_id=#{workerId} AND status='PROCESSING'
